review.body: Reviewed the current head `c9373f2` against the RECORD spec and Python's `csv` contract. Passing the full RECORD text through a `newline=""` text stream is the right boundary: it lets `csv.reader` handle quoted embedded CR/LF itself and avoids `str.splitlines()` treating unrelated Unicode line-separator characters as record boundaries. The regression covers both failure classes (embedded newline and U+2028), both RECORD read sites use the same fix, and the current CI/pre-commit/docs checks are green. I found no correctness or compatibility blocker on this head.
